doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: The white Memphis Ramblers copying the Memphis Jug Band
summary: Shade says Snooks's white band copied his numbers and that Mr. Peer then picked up on them.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: You remember Slucks and his Memphis Ramblers?
That's a white band around town. I thought you might have heard them.
No, I never know of him.
They used to play the Kansas City Blues and all that kind of stuff too, you know?
Yeah. I've heard of them, but I didn't never remember seeing them.
You remember them, Shane? You say you do, huh?
I remember them well. They copied behind us. We were the first band. Memphis jug band. Ever started a jug band in Memphis, Tennessee. I am.
And Snooks' white band copied after you?
Pick up on your numbers and all that, huh?
Yes, and Mr. Peer picked up on him.
Well, they made some good records.
